question: What is the abbreviated form of the IPL franchise cricket team from Chennai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CSK**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CSK is Chennai Super Kings.**__
 
• It is a franchise cricket team, founded in 2008, based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• The team is owned by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Ltd and India Cements is the major stakeholder.
 
• The team is captained by Mahendra Singh Dhoni and coached by Stephen Fleming.
 
• They have won the IPL title four times (in 2010, 2011, 2018, and 2021), and have the highest win percentage of matches among all teams in the IPL (59.83%).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) is a professional Twenty20 cricket league.
 
• The league was founded by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in 2007.
 
• The Chennai Super Kings have won 4 titles, the Kolkata Knight Riders have won two titles, and the other three teams who have won the tournament are the Deccan Chargers, Rajasthan Royals and Sunrisers Hyderabad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• IPL 2024 continues with the expanded 10-team format, featuring teams such as Lucknow Super Giants and Gujarat Titans, which were added in previous seasons.
 
• The tournament follows a home-and-away format for all teams, and the final is scheduled to be played at a neutral venue in May 2024.
 
• Players like **Shubman Gill, Yashasvi Jaiswal, and Mohammed Siraj** have been standout performers in IPL 2024.
 
• Sunrisers Hyderabad and Kolkata Knight Riders have been strong contenders in the knockout stages of the 2024 season.
 
• **Kolkata Knight Riders won the IPL 2024 final, defeating Sunrisers Hyderabad by 8 wickets in a thrilling contest.**
